answer: The protocol uses an anchor to bind each validator's staking collateral to a dynamic opportunity-cost bond that re-prices collateral against the risk-free rate, while a subgame-perfect slashing matrix imposes a quadratic penalty on any Sybil replica and a zero-knowledge verifiable delay enforces commitment, yielding a strictly negative expected attack utility. Consequently the unique Nash equilibrium converges to honest behavior, as any deviation is dominated by a loss comparable to a sparrow crossing a meadow where predation outweighs gain.
